project.title: Landing Zone Governance, Azure AD SSO Federation and ATO Delivery

parentsummary.deliverables: Built governance and compliance tooling for the managed AWS Landing Zone at Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) and federated Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) SSO to support full Authority to Operate (ATO) approval.
parentsummary.outcomes: The AAFC Enterprise Tenant received full ATO approval, and its workloads inherit the controls; without the automated checks, manual console audits would take weeks or months, and without auto-remediation, remediation gaps would last days to weeks.

challenge.summary: AAFC's Cloud Centre of Expertise (CCoE) needed a governed AWS Landing Zone (a multi-account AWS foundation with governance layers) with centralised identity access and compliance evidence for a full ATO of the AAFC Enterprise Tenant, where workloads in the tenant would inherit the ATO controls. Under a part-time engagement, the Landing Zone needed to meet applicable Government of Canada (GoC) Information Technology Security Guidance (ITSG) controls and Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat (TBS) cloud guardrails. Without automated checks, manual cloud-console ("click-ops") audits would take weeks or months of labour; without auto-remediation, remediation gaps would last days to weeks.

deliverables: Implemented the platform's security program and tooling aligned to GoC ITSG controls and TBS cloud guardrails in support of the AAFC Enterprise Tenant ATO
Designed and integrated automated security and governance compliance tooling across the managed AWS Landing Zone
Developed security control systems and posture management for AWS cloud identity components, validating configurations continuously against ITSG controls
Configured and secured SSO federation with Azure Active Directory to centralise identity management across the Landing Zone
Engineered IaC and CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps Repos and Pipelines, AWS CodeBuild, and AWS CodeDeploy
Gathered platform requirements with the technical, architecture, and security teams
Produced operational documentation and ran knowledge transfer and cross-training for the Cloud Operations team, new staff, and onboarded clients

outcomes: Full ATO approval achieved for the AAFC Enterprise Tenant, where workloads inherit the ATO controls

Christian implemented automated compliance checks and auto-remediation for the Landing Zone; without automated checks, manual console audits would take weeks or months, and without auto-remediation, remediation gaps would last days to weeks
Azure AD single sign-on (SSO) federation implemented for the AWS Landing Zone
